Chapter 692: Chapter 3: The Unending Cycle of Life and Death (Please Subscribe) _3

Battlefields starting with ‘A’ signify large alien battlefields.

Human civilization has established as many as two million battlefields of different races, the vast majority of which are small-sized otherworldly battlefields.

There are eight hundred and sixty thousand medium-sized otherworldly battlefields.

As for large alien battlefields? To date, there are only one hundred and thirty-five.

Each large alien battlefield is a meat grinder between peak clans, where the strongest beings of the cosmic starry skies converge the most.

The gaze of supreme beings is always watching closely.

...

Battlefield A098 is located near the central region.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit is flying cautiously.

Whether it is a small-sized otherworldly battlefield, a medium-sized otherworldly battlefield, or a large alien battlefield.

Space is extremely unstable, and transposition errors would be greatly “magnified”.

Such errors might be harmless in the cosmic starry skies, but on a battlefield?

If one carelessly transposed into the enemy’s lair, wouldn’t that be seeking death?

Therefore, under normal circumstances, no strong being dares to use transposition in the battlefields.

Lin Yuan is no exception.

Even though with the “Nine Steps of Space-Time,” Lin Yuan could minimize the errors to the lowest.

But the consumption from using this secret technique is too great, and the movement it generates is also significant.

It would create ripple after ripple in space.

After all, this secret technique is meant to be a ‘lifesaving’ method when there are no other choices.

When one is already in such a desperate situation, who still cares about the magnitude of the disturbance?

“This large alien battlefield… is really too vast…” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

It had taken him just over half a year to travel from the Milky Way Star Region to this battlefield.

In the years after that, he had been ‘slowly’ flying on the battlefield, heading towards the eternal spatial rift.

According to Lin Yuan’s understanding of Battlefield A098, this large alien battlefield has a diameter of over five hundred light-years, and even in the vastness of the cosmic void, it is considered a colossal entity.

It is said that the one hundred and thirty-five large battlefields established by human civilization were all crafted by the hands of supreme beings; they are the work of ultimate existences themselves, capable of enduring the battles between eleventh-rank lives.

“However… even just after entering the battlefield, I can already smell… the scent of World-Breaking Origin Force…” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

In the past, in both small-sized and medium-sized otherworldly battlefields, he could only accelerate the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force when he was near the eternal spatial rifts.

But in a large alien battlefield? Even at the edges, Lin Yuan could sense that the rate of accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force had increased.

Even if it was just a slight increase, it was nevertheless an increase. Compared to the small-sized and medium-sized otherworldly battlefields, this was a qualitative change.

“I wonder, once I truly approach that eternal spatial rift, to what extent will the rate of accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force increase?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat expectant in his heart.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit stood suspended in the air.

Since breaking through to the tenth rank, Lin Yuan occasionally entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to acquaint himself with the power that surged after his breakthrough.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm could even block the prying eyes of supreme beings, allowing Lin Yuan to display his power unbridledly here, with no need for any reservations.

Boom, boom, boom.

The terrifying energy fluctuations nearly swept across one-tenth of the secret realm. Compared to a normal Tenth Rank, Lin Yuan’s strength foundation was unfathomably stronger.

After passing through the Chaos Void with a gap of more than twelve light-years and receiving an Origin Source infusion for three hundred and thirty-three seconds, Lin Yuan underwent a complete metamorphosis from the inside out.

Compared to when he was at the Ninth Rank, Lin Yuan had become far too powerful.

It was as if he had transformed from an ant into a divine dragon.

Whirling.

The many layers of space were torn apart. The power Lin Yuan unleashed with mere gestures was enough to obliterate Tenth Rank Grade C and Grade B beings.

Only a Tenth Rank Grade A who had comprehended the Pillar-level Fusion Rules could endure in the aftermath of Lin Yuan’s unrestrained power.

But that was just enduring, like a small boat floating on a vast ocean, vulnerable to sinking at any moment.

“Master, your strength now has already surpassed the pinnacle of the Tenth Rank without the aid of any rule’s power…” The Six-Armed Silhouette of The Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm appeared in the distance, looking at Lin Yuan in the center of the vast power, utterly shocked.

The main method of cultivation for a Tenth Rank Life is to constantly fuse various rules.

And fusing rules is also the most important means of attack for a Tenth Rank Life.

But now?

Without utilizing any rules, Lin Yuan’s burst of power had surpassed the Tenth Rank category, which was simply unthinkable.

“Merely surpassing the pinnacle of the Tenth Rank?” Lin Yuan reined in his aura, somewhat disappointed.

Compared to his initial step into the Tenth Rank, Lin Yuan’s strength had increased greatly; he thought he might barely reach the threshold of the Eleventh Rank.

“Master…” The Six-Armed Silhouette fell silent.

The Tenth and the Eleventh Rank belong to completely different realms.

It’s not about surpassing the pinnacle of the Tenth Rank to reach the Eleventh.

If the pinnacle of the Tenth Rank is a hundred, then the Eleventh Rank is a thousand or even ten thousand.

Surpassing the pinnacle of the Tenth Rank, reaching one hundred and ten or one hundred and twenty, is still a long way from the Eleventh Rank.

During the glorious times of the Profound Yellow Lineage, there indeed were some abnormal Tenth Rank Lives who, with the aid of secret technique weapons, momentarily stood against Eleventh-Rank Life.

But Lin Yuan now wanted to reach the threshold of the Eleventh Rank with his own pure power alone.

This left the Six-Armed Silhouette at a loss for words.

If merely with one’s pure strength one can rival the Eleventh Rank, is that still a Tenth Rank Life?

…

After numerous attempts in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan had a rough idea of his current strength.

He was basically invincible among the Tenth Rank, with ordinary Grade A Tier 10 beings unable to last long against him.

If Lin Yuan disregarded everything, paying a huge price, he could perhaps briefly elevate his strength to the threshold of the Eleventh Rank.

For instance, by using the Divine Skill ‘Enhancement’.

Enhancing everything like his physical soul, spirit will, inner world, by ten times could lead to an estimated hundredfold or thousandfold increase in strength, certainly breaking into the Eleventh Rank realm.

“Fusion Rules…”

After examining for a while, Lin Yuan continued his cultivation and started to comprehend the Dao.

“The rules of life… the rules of death…” Lin Yuan raised both hands; his left hand was filled with warm vitality, while his right hand emanated a cold aura of death.

“Life and death, the cycle never ends?”

In Lin Yuan’s mind, numerous inspirations emerged, and the forces of life and death between his hands slowly began to merge.
